When when I notice I'm alone and have no one to reach out to, i become completely overwhelmed by intense emotions, my chest tightens, tears spill out, and I can't regain control. When when I'm alone and disconnected from others, i feel a sharp spike of dread, my heart races, and I scan for signs of abandonment. When when I'm alone and have no one to reach out to, i feel crushed by an unbearable heaviness, lose all motivation, can't get out of bed, and thoughts of being worthless consume me. When when I notice I'm isolated and have no one to turn to, i lose composure, my hands shake, my voice cracks, and I can barely hold myself together. When when I notice I'm alone and disconnected from people, i feel my chest tighten, my thoughts spiral with worry, and I can't stop my racing pulse. When when I realize someone has been lying to my face, i become extremely irritable, my temper flares unpredictably, and I swing between cold withdrawal and sudden outbursts. When when isolation and loneliness wash over me, my emotions burst out uncontrollably, I lose the ability to keep my feelings in check and feel completely overwhelmed. When when I realize I'm alone with no one around to talk to, i pace back and forth, my thoughts spiral with worry, and I can't sit still. When when I notice physical symptoms like nausea or stomach discomfort, i feel a knot in my chest, my thoughts spiral toward illness, and I can't stop worrying about my health. When when someone confronts me with accusations, criticism, or threats, my mood swings sharply and unpredictably—I snap, then sulk, then lash out, my demeanor darkening visibly from moment to moment. When when I have tasks or assignments that need to be completed, i replay potential problems repeatedly in my mind, imagine worst-case outcomes, and feel tense worrying about getting everything done right. When when I'm alone and start feeling disconnected from others, i become irritable and withdrawn, my mood darkens, and small annoyances feel unbearable. When when I put off what needs to be done and find myself doing nothing, my muscles tighten, my jaw clenches, and nervous tension runs through me despite just sitting there. When when I'm studying or doing schoolwork, i feel my heart race, my palms sweat, and I can't stop worrying about my performance. When when I feel physically sick and my body isn't working right, i berate myself, feel worthless, and cannot settle or accept my current state. When when I realize someone has lied to me or is trying to trick me, i lose my cool, my voice shakes, I get visibly upset and cannot hide my emotional reaction. When when I discover that someone close to me has been deceived, i become visibly shaken, my voice cracks, intense waves of anger and sadness crash over me.
